<p>The provider announced that schema-constrained responses are now available on every API tier. Developers can supply a JSON Schema with a request, and the response is guaranteed to parse against that schema.</p>
<p>Before this change the feature was limited to paid tiers. The announcement says there is no additional charge for using it, and that existing integrations do not need to change.</p>

<p>The company said the schema validator supports most of the JSON Schema specification, with a documented list of exceptions, and that requests using unsupported keywords are rejected with a clear error message.</p>
